'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|How's the mood? Battle-ready? Ready to shine in the Arena once more? Ready to shred some motherfuckers? The crowd is betting on you, so don't let the audience down! Speaking of that. You got some money? You gotta bet on yourself and then win a few times. You'll make tons of cash, and you'll be famous. Bring the money, I'll organize everything. Just be warned: if keep losing too often, you start again.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 1,000,000 [[Roubles]]
* Win three out of six matches in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in [[Arena]]
** Failure condition: Lose 4 matches

==Rewards==
* +5,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Ref]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.05'''</font>
* 35 [[GP coin]]s
** 37 [[GP coin]]s with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 40 [[GP coin]]s with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2,500,000 Roubles
** 2,625,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 2,875,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Supply crate (Rare)]]
{{quote|Here's your paycheck. I deducted all my services from it straight away: bribing opponents, fees, and all that. What, you thought I work for free?}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|Oh man, you almost did it. Try again, the audience still seems to favor you.}}
